notes.title: Missions are here!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]We have added a fun little way to score extra points while playing the game - completing missions![/p][p]From today, while playing the demo, you will notice that in each game, you are assigned 3 random missions from a small pool we added. This is still experimental and there is more to come, but we'd love to hear your feedback![/p][p]As always, thank you for your support! ❤️[/p]

notes.title: Hello Next Fest!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]We are thrilled to announce that [b]Cloudy with a Chance of Kittens[/b] will be part of this summer's Steam Next Fest! 🐱[/p][p]The festival starts in less than an hour, but we already can't wait! Come [url="https://discord.gg/B43hQTZyaS"]hang out with us on Discord[/url] and give our demo a spin. See you soon![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297882/72a8fe785024ecdde95b2ff1a81f44214732aa48.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Our demo is now LIVE!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]We've just released the free demo for Cloudy with a Chance of Kittens and would love to hear what you think about it! We hope you enjoy playing it as much as we enjoyed making it![/p][p]Thank you for your support! ❤️[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3627320/Cloudy_with_a_Chance_of_Kittens_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Hello World!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 🐈

We'd like to extend our warmest welcome to everyone new, and also to those who have been following our game from its early stages. It's great to have you!

Our Steam page is now live, and we are preparing for a 2025 release.
We are also aiming for a free demo release in early 2025, stay tuned for more updates!

THANK YOU for your interest in our tiny, cozy game!

Happy Holidays!
